definition: shiny liquid makeup painted on the lips
description: A young woman holds up a pink lip gloss tube, pulls out the applicator wand and paints the glossy pink liquid onto her lips in close-up. She pats them with a finger and shows off the shiny glass-like result, saying it is shiny like glass.

en.question: What is the woman in purple doing?

de.answer: Sie trägt Lipgloss auf ihre Lippen auf.
de.question: Was macht die Frau in Lila?

es.answer: Se está aplicando brillo de labios en los labios.
phrases: darse toquecitos en el labio inferior
mirar por encima de las gafas de sol

fr.answer: Elle applique du gloss sur ses lèvres.
